claims: The Artemis II Orion spacecraft successfully splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
The Artemis II Orion spacecraft splashed down on Friday, April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II Orion spacecraft splashed down at 8:07 p.m. EDT.
The Artemis II Orion spacecraft splashed down at 5:07 p.m. PDT.
Artemis II was a crewed mission.
Artemis II marked the first return to Earth from the Moon in over 50 years.
Astronauts were retrieved by the USS John P. Murtha.
The Artemis II crew consisted of NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and CSA astronaut Jeremy Hansen.
The Artemis II crew completed a lunar fly-by before returning to Earth
